support_messages.text: Hello, how does group ajo work?

**Group Better Ajo** offers seamless rotating thrift contributions:

• **₦0 Joining Fee**: Free for all contributors to join with an invite code.
• **₦0 Group Creation**: Free for Admins to create and manage their groups.
• **Transparent Rotations**: Positions are locked based on join order (Position 1, 2, etc.) to guarantee zero favoritism.
• **Lump Sum Packing**: When each round's pool is complete, the scheduled member packs their payout.

**Withdrawals on Better Ajo**:

• For Personal Ajo, you can request a withdrawal at any time from your Personal Dashboard.
• Payouts are made directly into your registered Nigerian bank account.
• Every withdrawal requires instant one-time verification (OTP) sent to your registered phone number.

Better Ajo makes Nigerian personal savings and rotating group ajo reliable, automated, and secure.
